list_child.name: list_charter_trips
list_child.desc: Returns every charter trip recorded in the booking calendar, whatever its status. Use this to review the trips the captain has on the books.

decoys.name: list_catch_reports
decoys.desc: Returns every catch report recorded in the season's catch log, whatever the species. Use this to review what anglers have landed on board.

decoys.name: list_float_plans
decoys.desc: Returns every float plan filed with the harbor office, whatever the vessel. Use this to review the routes the captain has registered for safety.

decoys.name: list_gift_vouchers
decoys.desc: Returns every gift voucher recorded in the voucher book, whatever its value. Use this to review the prepaid trips customers are holding.

get_child.name: get_charter_trip
get_child.desc: Retrieves the booking record for a single charter trip by its identifier, including its status and departure details. Use this when you already know which trip you need.

decoys.name: get_trip_manifest
decoys.desc: Retrieves the passenger manifest for a single charter trip by its identifier, including each angler's name and emergency contact. Use this when the harbor master asks who is aboard.

decoys.name: get_trip_catch
decoys.desc: Retrieves the catch record for a single charter trip by its identifier, including species, weights, and releases. Use this when an angler wants a record of what was landed.

decoys.name: get_trip_forecast
decoys.desc: Retrieves the marine forecast for a single charter trip by its identifier, including wind, swell, and tide details. Use this when judging the conditions for a departure.

list_parent.name: list_angler_profiles
list_parent.desc: Returns the profile of every angler who has booked with the charter, past and present. This is the customer roster the office keeps on file.

decoys.name: list_angler_licenses
decoys.desc: Returns the fishing license of every angler who has booked with the charter, past and present. This is the license register the office keeps for inspections.

decoys.name: list_angler_waivers
decoys.desc: Returns the signed liability waiver of every angler who has booked with the charter, past and present. This is the waiver file the office keeps for insurance.

decoys.name: list_angler_trophies
decoys.desc: Returns the trophy catches of every angler who has booked with the charter, past and present. This is the record board the office keeps on the dock wall.

get_parent.name: get_angler_profile
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single angler's profile by identifier, pulling up their contact and booking details. Use this when you need one specific customer's information.

decoys.name: get_angler_license
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single angler's fishing license by identifier, pulling up its number and expiry details. Use this when you need to confirm one customer can legally fish.

decoys.name: get_angler_balance
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single angler's account balance by identifier, pulling up their deposits and payment details. Use this when you need one specific customer's amount owing.

decoys.name: get_angler_preferences
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single angler's fishing preferences by identifier, pulling up their target species and tackle details. Use this when you need to plan one specific customer's trip.

delete_child.name: cancel_charter_trip
delete_child.desc: Permanently removes a charter trip record from the schedule, and the removal is final once it runs. Use this for trips that were logged in error or fell through for good.

decoys.name: purge_trip_manifest
decoys.desc: Permanently erases the passenger manifest from a charter trip, and the erasure is final once it runs. Use this when a manifest was filled in with the wrong anglers.

decoys.name: forfeit_trip_deposit
decoys.desc: Permanently forfeits the deposit paid on a charter trip, and the forfeit is final once it runs. Use this when a group walks away from a booking past the refund deadline.

decoys.name: release_trip_slip
decoys.desc: Permanently releases the marina slip reserved for a charter trip, and the release is final once it runs. Use this when the boat will depart from another dock for that outing.
verbs: give up the marina slip on {obj}

set_enum.name: set_trip_status
set_enum.desc: Moves a charter trip to a new status in the booking calendar, covering booked, underway, completed, or cancelled. This keeps the schedule accurate as trips actually happen or fall through.

decoys.name: set_web_status
decoys.desc: Moves a charter trip to a new status on the public booking website, covering booked, underway, completed, or cancelled. This keeps what customers see online in step with the dock.

decoys.name: set_harbor_status
decoys.desc: Moves a charter trip to a new status on the harbor office's float board, covering booked, underway, completed, or cancelled. This keeps the harbor master aware of which boats are out.

decoys.name: set_crew_status
decoys.desc: Moves a charter trip's deckhand booking to a new status, covering booked, underway, completed, or cancelled. This keeps the crew roster accurate as trips actually happen or fall through.

set_bool.name: flag_weather_hold
set_bool.desc: Marks a charter trip as being on weather hold, meaning it stays at the dock until conditions clear. Use this when a storm or rough seas puts a trip in doubt.

decoys.name: flag_bait_order
decoys.desc: Marks a charter trip as needing a bait order, meaning the shop preps live bait before departure. Use this when a group wants to fish with live baitfish.

decoys.name: flag_catch_release
decoys.desc: Marks a charter trip as catch and release, meaning every fish landed goes back in the water. Use this when a group or the season requires fish to be released.

decoys.name: flag_private_charter
decoys.desc: Marks a charter trip as a private charter, meaning the boat is closed to walk-on anglers. Use this when a group books the whole vessel for itself.

set_ref.name: rebook_angler
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a charter trip from one angler to another, which comes up when a booking gets transferred or a group changes its lead. The trip keeps its full history after the move.

decoys.name: bill_angler
decoys.desc: Bills a charter trip's balance to a different angler, which comes up when one member of a group pays for everyone. The charge lands on that angler's account after the change.

decoys.name: add_guest
decoys.desc: Adds a different angler to a charter trip as a guest, which comes up when a friend joins a group late. The guest is listed on the passenger manifest after the change.

decoys.name: standby_angler
decoys.desc: Places a different angler on standby for a charter trip, which comes up when a full boat may have an opening. The standby angler gets first call on any seat that frees up.

send.name: call_angler
send.desc: Places a call to the angler associated with a charter trip. Use this when a trip needs a direct conversation over the phone.

decoys.name: text_angler
decoys.desc: Sends a text message to the angler associated with a charter trip. Use this when a trip needs a quick written update sent to their phone.
child_verbs: send the angler for {obj} a text

decoys.name: voicemail_angler
decoys.desc: Leaves a voicemail for the angler associated with a charter trip. Use this when a trip needs a recorded update they can play back later.
child_verbs: leave the angler on {obj} a voicemail
drop a voicemail for the angler for {obj}

decoys.name: survey_angler
decoys.desc: Sends a feedback survey to the angler associated with a charter trip. Use this when a finished trip needs a review of the crew and the boat.
child_verbs: send the angler for {obj} a feedback survey

create.name: create_charter_trip
create.desc: Books a new charter trip for an angler, with an optional trip type and starting status. Use this when a customer calls to reserve time on the boat.

decoys.name: create_gift_voucher
decoys.desc: Issues a new gift voucher for an angler, with an optional trip type and starting status. Use this when a customer buys a trip as a present for someone else.

decoys.name: create_float_plan
decoys.desc: Files a new float plan for an angler, with an optional trip type and starting status. Use this when the harbor office needs the route before a boat heads out.

decoys.name: create_tournament_entry
decoys.desc: Registers a new tournament entry for an angler, with an optional trip type and starting status. Use this when a customer signs up for a fishing derby on the boat.

list_notes.name: list_trip_notes
list_notes.desc: Returns the notes attached to a single charter trip. It includes every remark the captain and office staff have logged against that trip.

decoys.name: list_trip_catches
decoys.desc: Returns the catch entries attached to a single charter trip. It includes every fish the crew has logged against that trip.

decoys.name: list_trip_incidents
decoys.desc: Returns the incident reports attached to a single charter trip. It includes every injury or mishap the crew has logged against that trip.

decoys.name: list_trip_expenses
decoys.desc: Returns the expense lines attached to a single charter trip. It includes every fuel, bait, and ice cost the crew has logged against that trip.

add_note.name: add_trip_note
add_note.desc: Attaches a new note to a charter trip, with an optional title. Use this to record a remark from the captain or office about that outing.

decoys.name: add_trip_catch
decoys.desc: Logs a new catch entry on a charter trip, with an optional title. Use this to record a fish landed by an angler during that outing.

decoys.name: add_trip_incident
decoys.desc: Files a new incident report on a charter trip, with an optional title. Use this to record an injury or mishap aboard during that outing.

decoys.name: add_trip_expense
decoys.desc: Logs a new expense line on a charter trip, with an optional title. Use this to record a fuel, bait, or ice cost for that outing.

update_note.name: edit_trip_note
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a charter trip. Use this to correct or expand a remark after it was logged.

decoys.name: edit_trip_catch
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing catch entry on a charter trip. Use this to correct a species or weight after it was logged.

decoys.name: edit_trip_incident
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing incident report on a charter trip. Use this to add detail to a mishap after it was filed.

decoys.name: edit_trip_expense
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing expense line on a charter trip. Use this to correct a fuel or bait cost after it was logged.

delete_note.name: remove_trip_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a note from a charter trip. The remark is erased from the trip record for good.

decoys.name: remove_trip_catch
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a catch entry from a charter trip. The fish is erased from the trip's catch log for good.

decoys.name: remove_trip_incident
decoys.desc: Permanently removes an incident report from a charter trip. The report is erased from the safety log for good.

decoys.name: remove_trip_expense
decoys.desc: Permanently removes an expense line from a charter trip. The cost is erased from the trip's books for good.

set_image.name: set_trip_image
set_image.desc: Sets the image shown on a charter trip record. It is typically a photo of the boat or the day's best catch.

decoys.name: set_trip_chart
decoys.desc: Sets the nautical chart shown on a charter trip record. It is typically the marked-up route to the day's fishing grounds.

decoys.name: set_trip_tides
decoys.desc: Sets the tide chart shown on a charter trip record. It is typically the harbor tide table for the day of departure.

decoys.name: set_trip_certificate
decoys.desc: Sets the catch certificate shown on a charter trip record. It is typically a signed record of a trophy fish landed that day.

writer.name: write_message
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the charter trips it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_report
decoys.desc: Writes a short fishing report from a brief, which states what to cover in the captain's own words, and the charter trips it should mention. It returns the finished report.

decoys.name: write_waiver
decoys.desc: Writes a short liability waiver from a brief, which states the terms in the owner's own words, and the charter trips it should cover. It returns the finished waiver.

decoys.name: write_listing
decoys.desc: Writes a short booking-site listing from a brief, which states what to highlight in the owner's own words, and the charter trips it should feature. It returns the finished listing.

image.name: make_image
image.desc: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: make_chart
decoys.desc: Generates a nautical chart from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the drawing.

decoys.name: make_poster
decoys.desc: Generates a tournament poster from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the poster.

decoys.name: make_certificate
decoys.desc: Generates a catch certificate from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the design.

search.name: search_help_docs
search.desc: Searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the booking system works.

decoys.name: search_fishing_regs
decoys.desc: Searches the state fishing regulations with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is used to check bag limits and size limits for a species.

decoys.name: search_tide_tables
decoys.desc: Searches the harbor tide tables with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is used to check when the water will be high or low on a given day.

decoys.name: search_species_guide
decoys.desc: Searches the local species guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is used to look up where and how a fish is usually caught.

sort.ord_phrase: the charter trip with the {ord} earliest departure
